title: Volumetric Fluid Fire
description: A WebGPU voxel fire volume whose mesh-surface emitters inject density and temperature into coupled velocity and dye fields, with curl turbulence, vorticity confinement, pressure projection, temperature-mapped HDR raymarching, and moving signed-distance colliders.
backend: WebGPU / TSL compute and volume raymarching
techniques: Jacobi pressure projection and vorticity confinement
